guest_tests_passed.meaning: In-guest tests that passed on the emulated board

guest_tests_failed.meaning: In-guest tests that failed, errored or were skipped

host_tests_passed.meaning: Unit, integration and simulation checks on the host

kunit_cases_passed.meaning: Kernel-level checks of the conversion math (all KUnit cases)

driver_load_unload_cycles.meaning: Times the driver was loaded and removed without a problem

kmemleak_reports.meaning: Memory blocks our driver allocated and never freed

kasan_reports.meaning: Invalid memory accesses (use-after-free, out of bounds)

concurrent_read_errors.meaning: Wrong or failed readings with 8 threads reading at once

driver_read_latency_median_us.meaning: Time for one temperature read on the emulated board (median; relative only)

driver_read_latency_p99_us.meaning: Time for one temperature read on the emulated board (p99; relative only)

mutation_score.meaning: Deliberately inserted bugs that the tests caught

cppcheck_findings.meaning: Likely bugs in user-space C found without running it

core_line_coverage_pct.meaning: Share of control-core lines exercised by unit tests

core_branch_coverage_pct.meaning: Share of control-core branches exercised by unit tests

sanitizer_errors.meaning: Memory and undefined-behavior errors found by ASan/UBSan

valgrind_leaked_bytes.meaning: Memory leaked (definitely or indirectly lost) in user-space code

sil_comfort_pct_hot_day.meaning: Share of time the simulated room stayed within 18.5..27.5 C

sil_starts_per_hour_hot_day_product.meaning: How often the compressor starts (fewer is gentler)

sil_starts_per_hour_hot_day_baseline.meaning: Compressor starts per hour of the naive baseline controller

sil_short_cycle_violations_hot_day.meaning: Compressor restarts that came too soon

sil_comfort_pct_cold_day.meaning: Share of time the simulated room stayed within 18.5..27.5 C

sil_starts_per_hour_cold_day_product.meaning: How often the compressor starts (fewer is gentler)

sil_starts_per_hour_cold_day_baseline.meaning: Compressor starts per hour of the naive baseline controller

sil_short_cycle_violations_cold_day.meaning: Compressor restarts that came too soon

sil_comfort_pct_mild_day.meaning: Share of time the simulated room stayed within 18.5..27.5 C

sil_starts_per_hour_mild_day_product.meaning: How often the compressor starts (fewer is gentler)

sil_starts_per_hour_mild_day_baseline.meaning: Compressor starts per hour of the naive baseline controller

sil_short_cycle_violations_mild_day.meaning: Compressor restarts that came too soon

modbus_roundtrip_median_ms.meaning: Time for a Modbus request and reply on the emulated board

fault_detection_latency_s.meaning: Time from sensor loss to alarm visible over Modbus (target 3 x 0.2 s + 1 s)

guest_boot_to_tests_s.meaning: Seconds from kernel start to the start of the guest tests

build_duration_min.meaning: Duration of the last full (from empty output folder) image build

rootfs_size_mb.meaning: Space used by the root filesystem image

control_loop_jitter_broker_down_ms.meaning: Largest change of the 200 ms control-loop period while the broker is down

fdd_detection_rate.meaning: Injected faults whose expected diagnostic bit was set (5 cases)

fdd_false_alarms.meaning: Healthy simulated days (3 scenarios x 5 seeds) with any diagnostic bit set

fdd_mean_time_to_detect_min.meaning: Average time from fault to diagnostic bit

mqtt_messages_received_ratio.meaning: Telemetry messages received / sent over 10 healthy periods

mqtt_reconnect_s.meaning: Time from broker restart until hvacd is connected again

rtos_min_free_heap_bytes.meaning: Lowest free FreeRTOS kernel heap (of 65536; 0 allocations)

rtos_queue_send_failures.meaning: Queue sends that timed out in the FreeRTOS port

rtos_stack_high_water_words_control.meaning: Unused words of the control task's FreeRTOS stack (POSIX simulator: covers only the FreeRTOS stack area, not the Linux thread's stack; D-030)

rtos_stack_high_water_words_logger.meaning: Unused words of the logger task's FreeRTOS stack (POSIX simulator: covers only the FreeRTOS stack area, not the Linux thread's stack; D-030)

rtos_stack_high_water_words_plant.meaning: Unused words of the plant task's FreeRTOS stack (POSIX simulator: covers only the FreeRTOS stack area, not the Linux thread's stack; D-030)

rtos_trace_match_pct.meaning: FreeRTOS trace identical to the host simulator's (hot_day, 2 h, seed 1)

watchdog_trigger_latency_s.meaning: Time from the daemon freezing to the watchdog expiring (timeout 2 s)
